passage_transcript: Our school is special, and our classmates are different but all great. Minmin is good at football and plays on the sports field. James is in the library, tells interesting stories, and helps other students learn English. The library is on the ground floor and looks like a boat. A helpful girl likes painting pictures and wants to be a painter. When James is afraid of the long rope, his classmates slow it down and cheer for him. At the end, he jumps in and skips.
